name: Game Engine Programmer
description: Build game engines and real-time simulations. Handle game loops, entity systems, physics integration, rendering pipelines, and asset management.
example_snippet:
program GameLoop:
    shape Entity holds:
        X as fractional number
        Y as fractional number
        VelocityX as fractional number
        VelocityY as fractional number

        method update takes Dt as fractional number produces nothing:
            put the sum of X and the product of VelocityX and Dt into X
            put the sum of Y and the product of VelocityY and Dt into Y
        end method
    end shape

    keep Player as unique handle to Entity with new Entity with 0.0 and 0.0 and 100.0 and 0.0
    call Player.update with 0.016
    print the text "Player at (" and Player.X and ", " and Player.Y and ")" and newline
end program
